name: Audit an evidence base
short_description: Audit at least 20 sources for provenance, relevance, dependence, and unresolved contradiction.
self_assessment: I can audit 20 sources without help and flag every material provenance or dependence issue.
description: Audit at least 20 sources for provenance, relevance, dependence, and unresolved contradiction. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Audit the sources behind a long report

builds_on.note: Source synthesis supports identifying dependence and contradiction.
